finding.text: The shots show only the top viewport (about 1000 px of a page that is 8597 px tall at 400, layout.json bands tab-panel h 8597), so the owner's core ask, "all 20 types as cards, grid at desktop", was not seen at any width. Re-shoot full-page or scroll to the card section before merge (requirements, Build/page.js; layout 1).

The task log has no "stage 1 landed" line with the worktree url and screenshot paths; the agent was closed by servex-close-loop mid-status ("the cards sit in a narrow column; … I'm now checking") with a harness-completed outcome. A fresh agent cannot tell whether the cards-in-a-grid problem was fixed (task folder, session.jsonl tail).
ux/Form/readme.md "On disk" omits `doc/` (`doc/file/*.md` per-file notes, `doc/files.jsonl`) that this diff adds, so the readme does not list everything inside its folder (Laws 9 and 11).

Stage 2 (stepper, quiz, JSON panel) is not in the diff; readme "More" still says "a stepper layout will reuse ux/Wizard", which is a plan, not a fact. The brief said stage 2 follows the mastermind's reply, so this is expected.
Selected ink is the literal `#1a1a1a` in Form.css lines 379 and 386; the brief said no new colour values. The readme names it as the same ink `button.prim` uses; use that token if one exists.

At 400 the two h2 section titles wrap to 2 lines (layout.json wraps, "The −3 … +3 scale…", "A short form you can fill"); `Skip` reads 1.7 lines in layout.json, which looks like a line-height measure on a 44 px button, not a wrap (shots/…/400.png).
No page lists the live instances of the new classes beyond the demo cards; the page does show each type with its live stored value, so the "show the class" rule is met in spirit.

The wide shots (1200, 1920, 3440) show only the top fold of /framework/ux/Form/, and no shot shows the stepper or quiz layout (stage 2 is in the diff), so those two layouts, the 20 cards and the grid at desktop were not seen at those widths — shots/*/sheet.png; only cards-400.png / cards-1920.png show cards.

Empty share rises with width (layout.json empty 0.34 at 400, 0.55 at 1200, 0.63 at 1920, 0.74 at 3440; widest text 366 to 707 px): the intro column stays narrow in a wide well, so most of a 3440 screen is blank — shots/.../3440.png, tab-panel band.

The H2 headings wrap to 2 lines at 400 ("The −3 … +3 scale, in four looks", "A short form you can fill") — layout.json 400 wraps. Acceptable for headings, but the first one eats the level-1 fold on a phone.

Gap check: no unindexed or stale doc found. ux/readme.md has the Form line; Form/readme.md lists every file, the 20 types, layouts, On disk, and the Wizard decision; doc/file/*.md covers page.js's Files tab. The task log holds "stage 1 landed" and "stage 2 landed" with commits, so a fresh agent can continue. Not merged yet (mastermind's decision).
